text: Stanley Wolpert's Jinnah of Pakistan was published in the US by Oxford University Press in 1984, and 500 copies were sent to Pakistan to be released for sale. Pakistan's military dictator General Zia-ul-Haq banned the book because it described Jinnah's dietary habits, which Wolpert had refused to remove. In 1989, Benazir and her government gave OUP permission to reprint it, and the book was released for sale in Pakistan.
meta_description: Jinnah of Pakistan by Stanley Wolpert: banned in Pakistan under Zia-ul-Haq after its 1984 publication; released for sale in 1989.
